title: RC-HEOM Hybrid Method for Non-Perturbative Open System Dynamics
summary: The Hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM) method is an important non-perturbative technique, allowing numerically exact treatment of open quantum systems with strong coupling and non-Markovian memory. However, its encoding of bath memory into auxiliary density operators often limits direct access to detailed bath information. In contrast, the reaction-coordinate (RC) mapping allows direct and transparent access to the dominant collective bath mode, but its perturbative and often Markovian treatment of the residual bath restricts its reliability.
